# DoUKnowBall

> DoUKnowBall.com is a free sports trivia and puzzle site with 100+ games
> across soccer, NFL, NBA, MLB, NHL, college sports, Formula 1, tennis, golf,
> NASCAR and combat sports. Daily puzzles (grids, connections, guess-the-player,
> higher or lower) plus deep career and manager simulations. Every game is free,
> runs in the browser, and needs no login. Data correctness is the house rule:
> real rosters, real stats, verified lineups.

## Popular games

- [Soccer Career](https://douknowball.com/soccer-career): season by season football life sim, the site's flagship
- [College Grid](https://douknowball.com/college-grid): college football 3x3 grid puzzle
- [Footle](https://douknowball.com/footle): daily guess-the-player with feedback tiles
- [NFL Conquest](https://douknowball.com/conquest): imperialism map where winners annex whole empires
- [NBA Connections](https://douknowball.com/nba-connections): group 20 players into four hidden links
- [Rebuild Challenge](https://douknowball.com/rebuild): inherit a real club, survive the transfer window
